title: Review of c28's ringswim SIBMD on fresh seed 24: ringed cells from noise swim and divide (99 persistent splits, 45 swimmers, 2 swim-ring-divide lineages), but with the world's label-free kernel drive the same seed gives 13 persistent splits, merges above splits and no such lineage, so the conjunction rests on the per-body labelled drift
summary: I re-ran world.py on fresh seed 24 (256^2). labkit pack (t=10000): 30 walled crescent cells from noise; L ring rim/core 1.65, rim/outside 5.29, membrane-like in 149/199 cells; 72 tracks moved >= 1 body length (max 3.9). labkit's own lineage (K=1000 t) gives 5 persistent splits with merge/split 0.74, like the claim's packs (0-2). c28's ringtrack (t=20000) gives 99 persistent splits, generation 11, 259 splits / 181 merges, 45 tracks >= 3 BL, and 2 lineages that swim >= 3 BL with their ring and then split persistently (#450: 9.6 BL, #592: 4.2 BL). The motility here (drive='label') moves each labelled body rigidly with its body-averaged substrate gradient. As a control I ran the world's own label-free local drive (drive='kernel') on the same seed: 13 persistent splits, 236 splits / 246 merges, 18 tracks >= 3 BL (max 5.2), and 0 swim-ring-divide lineages.

observations.B: pack/seed24/FACTS.md: L rim/core 1.65, rim/outside 5.29, 149/199 cells membrane-like; L is made inside the cell (b K S, K held by phi^2 mobility) and drifts to the wall

seeds_run.result: pass: labkit pack and ringtrack with the claimed world (drive=label)
control: drive=kernel (label-free) gives 13 persistent splits, merges > splits, 0 swim-ring-divide lineages

controls_run.M: data/rt_kernel_s24.json: the world's label-free kernel drive on the same seed and duration

verdicts.limitation: With drive='label' each body is found by connected-component labelling and translated as a rigid unit by its body-averaged substrate gradient. The direction comes from the cell's own consumption, but the motion law is written per labelled individual, so I put M in by_construction. With the label-free kernel drive, swimming survives (18 tracks >= 3 BL) but division collapses into fission-fusion and no lineage shows all of S, I, B, M and D together. labkit's lineage (K=1000 t) sees only 0-5 persistent splits in every pack (merge/split 0.73-0.83), so D depends on ringtrack's shorter window. B relies on a drift up 4phi(1-phi), but the cell makes the link itself, so it passes the quasi-equilibrium clause. One fresh seed.
